remarks: Welcome to Classic one of the most luxurious residences located in the heart of lively downtown Stamford. Walk to shops, theaters, bars and popular restaurants. This upscale condo community offers luxurious lifestyle with 24-hour concierge services, new state of the art fitness center, clubroom with fireplace, one of a kind roof top pool, sundeck. Heat, hot water and cooking gas are included in rent. This spacious open concept 2 bedroom, 2 bath unit features: separate formal dining room or a den, wide plank wood flooring, walls of windows, modern kitchen with granite counters & stainless appliances, marble master bath, full size washer and dryer in unit, each room with access to spacious balcony. A RARE FIND - 2 reserved INDOOR GARAGE SPACES (on level 2nd level #190 & 191 next to each other)! Open and airy Southern exposure with dramatic sunset and cityscape views. Please note photos were taken when prior tenant was residing. A cosmopolitan lifestyle awaits! Agents please read agent remarks regarding application and move-in requirements. AGENTS PLEASE READ AGENT REMARKS FOR APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS.
